title: RAG Content Quality Auditor
description: Choose a website or an existing dataset. Get explainable recommendations before RAG ingestion.

mode.title: Source
mode.description: Audit accessible website pages or content already stored in an Apify dataset.

start_url.title: Website URL
start_url.description: Public HTTP(S) starting page. Only this hostname is visited. Ignored in dataset mode.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum page attempts or source dataset rows, including failures and skipped content.

dataset_id.title: Source dataset ID
dataset_id.description: Required for Existing dataset mode. Enter an ID or owner~dataset name that your Apify account can read.

max_depth.sectionDescription: The defaults suit a small first audit.
max_depth.title: Link depth
max_depth.description: Start page is depth 0. Sitemap pages are depth 1. Set 0 to audit only the starting page.

include_patterns.title: Include URL patterns
include_patterns.description: Optional full-URL globs. The suggested first run stays in the Python tutorial. Replace this pattern for another section, or clear the list to include all eligible same-host URLs.

exclude_patterns.title: Exclude URL patterns
exclude_patterns.description: Full-URL globs to skip. Exclusions take precedence, including for redirects.

respect_robots_txt.title: Respect robots.txt
respect_robots_txt.description: Check observed crawl rules before fetching pages. Unavailable rules are reported; server/network errors cause conservative skipping.

detect_duplicates.title: Detect duplicates
detect_duplicates.description: Compare extracted main content within this run before scoring pages.

check_ai_metadata.title: Check llms.txt files
check_ai_metadata.description: Observe /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt once. Their absence does not affect scores. Website mode only.

max_concurrency.title: Concurrent page requests
max_concurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous page fetches. Lower values reduce load on the source website.

request_timeout_secs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
request_timeout_secs.description: Deadline for one HTTP attempt including body transfer. Retries and redirects are separately bounded.
